purpose: Determine whether bounded hierarchical CIAO combination is numerically equivalent to the frozen direct operation and can safely replace only the tool-capacity failure in a separately named successor.

input.observed_failure_stage: CIAO addresp while directly merging the 3812-cell Bullet integrated response
input.observed_failure_boundary: No combined response, fit, temperature, source invariant, lensing target, halo map or gravity result was produced.

hierarchy.ordering: preserve exact validated-index order within chunks and preserve chunk order in the final combination
hierarchy.method: CIAO combine_spectra 4.18 with method=sum, bscale_method=asca and exp_origin=pha at both levels
hierarchy.reason: CIAO defines the sum-method ARF as an exposure-weighted mean and the RMF as ARF-and-exposure weighted, operations that are associative when chunk exposures are retained. This protocol tests the actual implementation rather than assuming equivalence.

decision.pass: Every source spectrum is bitwise-count equivalent; background, ARF and RMF arrays pass all frozen tolerances; response structure and exposure accounting are preserved in all four controls. A separately named full-combination successor may then be frozen without changing cell membership or spectral science.
decision.fail: Do not use hierarchical combination and do not run the regional spectral chain. Record the implementation falsification and choose an independently derived response-combination method before opening a temperature or source result.

claim_boundary: V19DG is an implementation-equivalence test, not a gas-temperature, gravity or lensing result.
The four controls are chosen from source identities and manifest order, not response values or spectral outcomes.
A pass authorizes freezing a separately named successor; it does not authorize rewriting or rerunning the terminally failed V19X2 protocol.
No source-invariant, lensing, halo, galaxy-rotation, action, gravity-parameter or holdout payload is opened.
